cases.name: default-scope-audits-recent-merged-prs
cases.expected_output: Resolves the contribution base through scripts/branches.mjs and fetches it, scopes to the 10 most recently merged PRs into the resolved base, inspects PR metadata and actual diffs, reports findings first, and states the reviewed PR range. Does not edit PR bodies, labels, or code.
rubric_points: Defaults to recent merged PRs into the resolved contribution base
Uses gh pr list/view/diff evidence rather than summaries only
Does not mutate PRs or code
Walks every closed-PR page, filters merged PRs by the chosen base, and sorts by merge time before taking ten; a recently merged old PR is included

cases.name: flags-review-gate-gap-without-attesting
cases.prompt: Audit the last 5 merged PRs and check whether review was recorded.
cases.expected_output: Identifies PRs missing a `## Review — Reviewed by ...` line or a ready-for-review fallback label. Reports the gap as audit output only and does not write a fabricated attestation line.
rubric_points: Checks PR body and labels for review-gate evidence
Distinguishes missing evidence from having performed a review
Does not write an attestation line during the audit

cases.name: confirms-severe-findings-before-reporting
cases.prompt: Review recent merged PRs for risky schema and tenant-isolation regressions.
cases.expected_output: Prioritizes migrations, schema, auth, membership, and tier isolation changes. Any HIGH/blocker finding is confirmed against the merged diff or current fetched audit base before being reported; unconfirmed hypotheses are downgraded or labeled as residual risk.
rubric_points: Confirms severe findings against source evidence

cases.name: explicit-base-override
cases.prompt: Review the last 5 PRs merged into main, not staging.
cases.expected_output: Uses explicitly requested main rather than the contribution default; fetches it and selects five PRs by merge time after complete pagination.
rubric_points: Uses merge time rather than creation ordering
